Thank you for your letter requesting financial assistance for your Special Olympics program.
While we are certainly sympathetic to your situation and we appreciate your thinking of Philip Morris, we are
unable to offer you assistance. I hope you will understand that the high volume of individual requests for
financial assistance that we receive precludes us from participating in what are likely deserving projects.
Thank you again for contacting us. Please accept our best wishes that you are successful in your efforts.
MARLBORO BENSON & HEDGES MERIT VIRGINIA SLIMS PARLIAMENT LIGHTS BASIC CAMBRIDGE ALPINE
